title: pleiocardia orbiculata
intro: Pleiocardia orbiculata, commonly known as the sea fan coral or sea fan, is a type of marine coral that belongs to the family Cardiidae. The health benefits of Pleiocardia orbiculata include its potential to inhibit the growth of certain bacteria and fungi, which can help in wound healing and preventing infections. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Pleiocardia orbiculata include various compounds such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and fatty acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
